experiment.title: you approve every agent action — that's not oversight
experiment.hook: you're the slowest agent in your fleet.
experiment.hypothesis: a mistake-callout hook ('you approve every action — that's noise') + a save-bait tool-policy list drives more saves and comments than a pure thesis carousel
experiment.caption:
watched a founder friend demo his agent setup last month, he had like 30 agents running and he was so proud, and then i noticed he was clicking approve every four seconds. just approve approve approve. so i asked him when's the last time you actually said no, and he went quiet. right? because that's the tell — if you approve everything you're not reviewing anything, you're just a very slow queue with a pulse. and most of what agents do is reversible anyway. drafting, planning, iterating, who cares, let it run. the moment that actually needs you is the irreversible one: the publish, the payment, the merge, the message that can't be unsent. so gate THAT. tool policy sits at the boundary, unknown high-risk tool fails closed, everything else just moves. escalate consequence, not activity. your attention is the scarcest thing in the whole loop and you're burning it on keystrokes

#aiagents #aiops #agentic #humanintheloop #aiinfra #buildinpublic #multiagent

slides.headline: you're the slowest agent in your fleet.
slides.subtext: and it's why the one risky action slips through.

slides.headline: 50 agents. every one pings you. you became the queue.
so you rubber-stamp. and the action that mattered slips by.
slides.subtext: blanket approval is the same as no review.

slides.headline: human review should scale with consequence, not activity.
slides.subtext: reserve your attention for what can't be undone.

slides.headline: most agent work is reversible. let it run.
slides.subtext: drafts, plans, iterations — nobody needs to sign off on those.

slides.headline: policy gates the boundary: publish · pay · message · merge.
slides.subtext: unknown high-risk tool? fails closed. every time.

slides.headline: everything else runs. you get the receipt, not the keystrokes.
escalate consequence, not activity.
slides.subtext: what would you actually want to approve? drop it below.
